schema:
CREATE TABLE address (
  address_id,
  city,
  country_id,
  street_name,
  street_number
);

CREATE TABLE book (
  book_id,
  isbn13,
  language_id,
  num_pages,
  publication_date,
  publisher_id,
  title
);

CREATE TABLE cust_order (
  customer_id,
  dest_address_id,
  order_date,
  order_id,
  shipping_method_id
);
